decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Scion of Draco to put pressure on the opponent. With a mix of land-fetching cards like Flooded Strand and Lightning Bolt for removal, the deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. Additionally, cards like Stubborn Denial and Leyline Binding provide protection and disruption, ensuring that the aggressive strategy can push through the opponent's defenses.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and versatile spells like Supreme Verdict and Prismatic Ending helps maintain dominance over the opponent. Key cards such as The One Ring and Leyline Binding provide additional control elements, while the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard offers synergy with the deck's creature base. By efficiently disrupting the opponent's game plan and establishing a strong board presence, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the competition in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures such as Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The key strategy is to control the board using counterspells like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler while setting up the combo pieces. Wrenn and Six provide additional card advantage and graveyard recursion, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide a game-winning combo with Leyline Binding. The land base is optimized to support the combo pieces while ensuring consistency in mana.

The deck revolves around utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to fill your graveyard with powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Yargle to then bring them back with Goryo's Vengeance for explosive plays. It also includes ways to disrupt your opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Lightning Bolt. The main goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful spells, pushing for a fast and impactful victory in the game.

The deck focuses on cycling through cards to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then casting Living End to return them all to the battlefield. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of creatures while simultaneously disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation. With the right combination of cards, the deck can create a powerful board state in a short amount of time, allowing for a quick victory through a combination of card advantage and massive creatures.

This deck focuses on using control elements to stall the game while setting up powerful combos with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Omnath, Locus of Creation. It looks to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, while also utilizing cards like Wrenn and Six to generate value over time. The deck also includes Leyline Binding and Delighted Halfling to further control the opponent's plays and protect its own game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

This UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption. By utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo advantage throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Expressive Iteration provide additional value and card advantage, allowing the deck to adapt to various matchups. With a focus on quick, proactive plays and efficient removal, this deck looks to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively using efficient creatures like Ragavan and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by powerful spells such as Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The key strategy is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to dig for key cards and keep the pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats and versatile answers.

This deck focuses on utilizing control and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi. The deck also aims to stabilize the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Solitude, while ramping and fixing mana with cards like Omnath and Leyline Binding. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers, removal spells, and card advantage engines allows the deck to control the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

This control deck focuses on utilizing planeswalkers and powerful spells to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By establishing a strong mana base and utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck can control the tempo of the game and protect its win conditions. The inclusion of powerful spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude allows for efficient removal and disruption, while cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation provide a powerful late-game threat. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect and recur our key creatures. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and proactive, utilizing a combination of aggression and disruption to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, efficient creatures and spells to apply early pressure on the opponent. It includes cards that can quickly deal damage, such as Lightning Bolt and Monastery Swiftspear, while also utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional flexibility in mana costs. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with direct damage and aggressive creatures, making it a strong choice for fast-paced gameplay in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to use mill cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity to deplete the opponent's library quickly. This is supported by cards like Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter, which can mill a large number of cards at once. The deck also includes control elements like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, there are draw spells like Visions of Beyond and Preordain to help find key combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to mill the opponent out as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of equipping Colossus Hammer onto Puresteel Paladin with the help of Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid. This allows for a powerful and fast win condition, especially when backed up by Inkmoth Nexus for infect damage. The deck also includes multiple tutors and protection spells to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. With the right setup, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a deadly combination of equipment and creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with Cascade, aiming to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and tempo advantage. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and outvalue opponents. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its game plan and disrupt opposing strategies. The key strategy is to cascade into powerful spells and maintain tempo advantage to close out the game quickly.

The key strategy of this Aggro Jund deck is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent using efficient threats such as Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Wrenn and Six. The deck is able to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate while also deploying powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and keep the opponent on the back foot throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly casting Cascading spells, utilizing cards like Ardent Plea and Violent Outburst to trigger Cascade and cheat out powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Subtlety. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant while disrupting their strategy with counterspells like Force of Negation. The deck also includes versatile cards like Shardless Agent and Fire/Ice for additional control and card advantage. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain a fast tempo and pressure the opponent with efficient Cascade spells and aggressive threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate additional mana and enable explosive plays with Primeval Titan. Using lands like Tolaria West, Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, and The Mycosynth Gardens, it aims to quickly ramp up and search for combo pieces using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Summoner's Pact. The goal is to efficiently assemble the necessary components to cheat out powerful threats like Cultivator Colossus and Boseiju, Who Endures, overwhelming the opponent with big threats and generating significant value from lands and creatures.
